legislation.notes: SB 540 enrolled June 17, 2026 and awaiting Gov. Kelly Ayotte's signature (LegiScan full docket) — not yet signed. Would allow one plug-in solar device up to 1,200W per customer, certified by a nationally recognized testing laboratory, with no utility approval or fees. Provisions would take effect about July 27, 2026 if signed.
